arStrings.szText: The Midwife cult works to draw forth what was cast beyond the Void.

Istel and I uncovered that the Midwife cultists are preparing a path for their demon lord from the Void. When we faced its spectral echo, it boasted of its rebirth into Sanctuary. 

The ritual site lies somewhere in Athulua near the Bridge of Portemos, in a place called the Birthing Pit. I need to meet Istel there at once.

I found the location of the Birthing Pit in Athulua. Istel and I broke the barricade to gain entry.

The exterior looks like a simple, mundane house, but I can feel the danger waiting beyond the threshold. I need to be ready.

The ritual site of the Midwife cultists lies somewhere in Athulua near Temis, in a place called the Birthing Pit.

Istel and I will need to search the derelict houses in the area. One of them must hide the pit.
